name: Neural Network Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative refinements for neural-network forward, loss, backward, and parameter-update runtime stages.

operations.name: Detect Gradient Explosion
operations.intent: Measure gradient norm after backpropagation so unstable training is visible before parameter update.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for gradients that have become too large.

rewrite.before_summary: Backward pass output feeds downstream training stages directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Gradient explosion detection is inserted after the backward pass.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds explicit gradient-scale evidence without changing model outputs.

operations.name: Analyze Activation Statistics
operations.intent: Measure dead activation fraction after the forward pass for opaque backbones, heads, and feature blocks.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for activations that are stuck off too often.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass activations feed loss or downstream stages directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Activation statistics analysis is inserted after the forward pass.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds activation-health evidence for architecture and training review.

operations.name: Monitor Loss Convergence
operations.intent: Monitor loss-history change after loss computation to flag plateaued training.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for loss that has stopped improving.

rewrite.before_summary: Loss values feed backward pass or training control directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Loss convergence monitoring is inserted after loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds convergence evidence while preserving the loss contract.

operations.name: Check Weight Distribution
operations.intent: Check layer weight norms after parameter update so imbalanced weights are visible.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for weight norms that differ too much across layers.

rewrite.before_summary: Updated parameters feed the next training or inference stage directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Weight distribution checking is inserted after parameter update.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds parameter-scale evidence without changing the learned model state.

operations.name: Stochastic Weight Averaging
operations.intent: Average late-training checkpoints so recurring SWA solution deltas are represented as a reusable training-loop refinement.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA) after parameter updates to average several late checkpoints.

rewrite.before_summary: The final checkpoint is used directly after training.
rewrite.after_summary: Late checkpoints are averaged into an SWA model before final evaluation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves model output semantics while smoothing weight-space variance.

operations.name: Mixed-Precision Training
operations.intent: Configure fp16 or bf16 automatic mixed precision before neural-network forward and backward passes without changing the model topology.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Run training with FP16 or BF16 autocast, and loss scaling when needed, to reduce memory use and improve throughput while keeping the same network structure.

rewrite.before_summary: Training runs in default numeric precision.
rewrite.after_summary: Automatic mixed-precision autocast and loss scaling are configured before forward/backward passes.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves training semantics while changing numeric execution policy.

operations.name: Adversarial Weight Perturbation
operations.intent: Insert AWP between gradient computation and parameter update when robustness-oriented training is required.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Perturb weights adversarially during training before applying the normal update.

rewrite.before_summary: Gradients flow directly into the parameter update.
rewrite.after_summary: Adversarial Weight Perturbation modifies the update step before parameters are committed.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves the training-loop contract while adding robustness regularization.

operations.name: Progressive Image Resizing
operations.intent: Insert a resolution schedule or high-resolution input policy so image models train from cheaper views to larger task-relevant views.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Train image models with progressive resizing or high-resolution crops, windows, and tiles when small inputs miss important detail.

rewrite.before_summary: Images feed the forward pass at one fixed resolution.
rewrite.after_summary: A progressive resizing or high-resolution input policy prepares inputs before forward passes.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves image classification or segmentation outputs while changing the training curriculum.

operations.name: CNN-Recurrent Sequence Backbone
operations.intent: Insert a CNN plus bidirectional LSTM/GRU sequence encoder before task loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a 1D/2D CNN followed by Bidirectional LSTM or GRU layers for sequence, trajectory, review, or video-style inputs.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed loss computation directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A CNN-recurrent sequence encoder refines forward-pass features before loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves task outputs while adding temporal or ordered-context representation.

operations.name: Lightweight CNN Regression Head
operations.intent: Insert a compact convolutional backbone or head with pooling for image, keypoint, ROI, or continuous target prediction.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a shallow CNN, small multi-layer CNN, max-pooling CNN, or CNN regressor when the task needs local image features without a large pretrained backbone.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed a generic head or loss computation.
rewrite.after_summary: Forward-pass features pass through a compact CNN with pooling and a regression or task head before loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves sample-level prediction semantics while changing the local feature extractor and output head.

operations.name: Generalized Mean Pooling
operations.intent: Insert GeM or GAP-style global pooling after convolutional feature extraction.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Pool feature maps with Generalized Mean pooling or Global Average Pooling before the prediction head.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass feature maps feed the head or loss directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Feature maps are globally pooled with GeM/GAP before the head or loss.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction semantics while changing spatial feature aggregation.

operations.name: Multi-Sample Dropout
operations.intent: Insert multi-sample dropout before loss computation to stabilize logits.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Average several dropout-mask predictions from the task head before computing loss.

rewrite.before_summary: One forward pass produces logits for loss computation.
rewrite.after_summary: Several dropout-mask logits are averaged before loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves output shape while reducing head-level variance.

operations.name: Hard Negative Mining
operations.intent: Insert hard-negative or hard-triplet selection before contrastive, triplet, or ranking losses.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Choose difficult negative examples or triplets before computing embedding or ranking loss.

rewrite.before_summary: Embeddings feed loss computation without mined negatives.
rewrite.after_summary: Hard negatives or hard triplets are selected and fed into loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves embedding outputs while changing which training pairs dominate the loss.

operations.name: Multi-Label Sigmoid Head
operations.intent: Insert a multi-label or auxiliary multi-task sigmoid classification head before loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Predict independent label logits with a sigmoid head for multi-label or multi-task classification.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed loss computation directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A multi-label sigmoid head emits independent label logits before loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves downstream loss semantics while changing the prediction head contract for multi-label tasks.

operations.name: Multi-Label Focal/BCE Loss
operations.intent: Insert multi-label focal, BCE, or label-smoothed BCE loss handling before generic loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use multi-label focal loss or BCE with label smoothing for imbalanced multi-label classification.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass outputs feed a generic loss.
rewrite.after_summary: Multi-label focal/BCE loss handling feeds the generic loss stage.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves label output shape while changing the per-label loss weighting.

operations.name: ArcFace Margin Loss
operations.intent: Insert additive angular margin loss preparation for ArcFace and sub-center ArcFace variants.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use ArcFace or sub-center ArcFace angular margins for identity, retrieval, or fine-grained classification embeddings, including Dynamic Margin ArcFace Scaling, Dynamic Margin Scaling, and Dynamic Margin scaling.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass embeddings feed a generic classification or metric loss.
rewrite.after_summary: ArcFace-style angular-margin preparation feeds loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves class or embedding outputs while changing the margin geometry used for training.

operations.name: Training Data Augmentation
operations.intent: Insert reusable label-preserving augmentation before neural-network forward passes.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Apply label-preserving transformations such as mixing examples, masking regions or frequency bands, rotations, flips, color changes, blur, or noise during training.

rewrite.before_summary: Training batches feed the forward pass directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Training batches are augmented before the forward pass.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves label semantics while increasing training variation.

operations.name: Domain-Specific Fine-Tuning
operations.intent: Insert domain-specific pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, or adapters before task training.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Start from domain-adapted weights, curated supervised fine-tuning, or small task adapters when a generic pretrained model lacks the needed domain context.

rewrite.before_summary: The task model starts from a generic initialization.
rewrite.after_summary: The task model starts from domain-specific pretraining or adapter-tuned weights.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves model outputs while changing initialization and adaptation context.

operations.name: Adaptive Batch Normalization
operations.intent: Adapt batch-normalization statistics for domain, location, plate, or deployment-shifted data.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Apply Adaptive Batch Normalization, including per-location or per-plate batch-normalization adaptation.

rewrite.before_summary: Inputs use fixed batch-normalization statistics.
rewrite.after_summary: Batch-normalization statistics are adapted before forward passes.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves output shape while adapting normalization to the target domain.

operations.name: ROI Cropping Detector
operations.intent: Crop relevant regions before the main model forward pass.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use MegaDetector or another detector for animal cropping or ROI cropping before classification, detection, or retrieval.

rewrite.before_summary: Full images feed the forward pass.
rewrite.after_summary: Detected regions of interest feed the forward pass.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves task labels while focusing model input on relevant regions.

operations.name: Transformer Sequence Aggregation
operations.intent: Aggregate sequence, slice, frame, or event-level features before loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use sequence-level feature aggregation or transformer-based sequence aggregation before the task head or loss.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed loss computation directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Forward-pass features are aggregated across sequence context before loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction targets while adding sequence-context aggregation.

operations.name: Optimizer Schedule
operations.intent: Configure learning-rate or optimizer decay schedules before parameter updates.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use layer-wise learning-rate decay, cyclic learning rates, Adam learning-rate decay, Adam weight decay, or related optimizer schedules.

rewrite.before_summary: Gradients feed a default optimizer update.
rewrite.after_summary: Gradients feed an optimizer update configured with a schedule or decay policy.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves training-loop semantics while changing update policy.

operations.name: Dropout and L2 Regularization
operations.intent: Insert regularization before loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Apply dropout, spatial dropout, heavy dropout, L2 regularization, or weight decay to stabilize neural-network training.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed loss computation with default regularization.
rewrite.after_summary: Regularized features or head outputs feed loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves output shape while reducing overfitting risk.

operations.name: Test-Time Augmentation
operations.intent: Insert inference-time augmentation and prediction aggregation after the model forward pass.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Run inference under label-preserving views such as crops, flips, scales, windows, or other safe augmentations, then average or otherwise aggregate the predictions.

rewrite.before_summary: One inference view produces predictions directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Multiple augmented inference views are aggregated before prediction output.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction targets while smoothing inference over safe label-preserving transforms.

operations.name: Siamese Metric Backbone
operations.intent: Insert a shared-weight Siamese network for metric-learning tasks.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a Siamese ResNet, Siamese VGG16, or similar shared-weight pair encoder before metric or identity loss.

rewrite.before_summary: Single-example features feed loss computation.
rewrite.after_summary: Pairwise Siamese embeddings feed loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves embedding semantics while adding paired comparison structure.

operations.name: Large-Backbone Scale Attention
operations.intent: Insert a high-capacity vision backbone and scale-aware attention block before task loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a larger image backbone such as ConvNeXt-Large, EfficientNet-V2, or a comparable pretrained vision model, then combine multi-scale features with scale-aware attention.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed the task head or loss through a generic backbone representation.
rewrite.after_summary: High-capacity backbone features are fused with scale-aware attention before the task head or loss.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction targets while increasing visual feature capacity and scale handling.

operations.name: Graph Interaction Network
operations.intent: Insert a graph neural network for proximity, kinematics, contact, or particle interaction modeling.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a GNN or interaction graph neural network for kinematics, proximity, contact, or particle-tracking interactions.

rewrite.before_summary: Independent entity features feed loss computation.
rewrite.after_summary: Graph-interaction features feed loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves entity predictions while adding relational message passing.

operations.name: PointRend Boundary Refinement
operations.intent: Refine segmentation boundaries after the forward pass.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use PointRend for boundary refinement in segmentation or instance-segmentation pipelines.

rewrite.before_summary: Coarse masks feed loss computation or output directly.
rewrite.after_summary: Point-based boundary-refined masks feed loss computation or output.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves mask semantics while improving boundary detail.

operations.name: Cross-Encoder Backbone
operations.intent: Insert a paired-input cross-encoder for ranking or relevance tasks.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a DeBERTa-v3, DeBERTa-v4, or DeBERTa-XXL cross-encoder for query-document, prompt-answer, or pairwise relevance modeling.

rewrite.before_summary: Separate features feed the ranking or classification loss.
rewrite.after_summary: Jointly encoded pair features feed the ranking or classification loss.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves ranking output semantics while changing pair representation.

operations.name: Preference Ranking Head
operations.intent: Insert Bradley-Terry or pairwise preference modeling before loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Bradley-Terry preference modeling, preference ranking, or pairwise ranking optimization.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass scores feed a generic loss.
rewrite.after_summary: Pairwise preference scores feed a Bradley-Terry-style ranking loss.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves ranking semantics while changing supervision to pair preferences.

operations.name: Dice/BCE Loss
operations.intent: Insert segmentation or multilabel loss handling before generic loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Binary Cross-Entropy loss, Dice loss, or Dice plus Binary Cross-Entropy loss for segmentation or multilabel masks.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass logits feed a generic loss.
rewrite.after_summary: Dice/BCE loss handling feeds the generic loss stage.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves mask or label outputs while changing loss geometry.

operations.name: Multiple Instance Learning Head
operations.intent: Insert bag-level aggregation for patch, tile, instance, or slide-level supervision.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) head, including Chowder Multiple Instance Learning (MIL), to aggregate instance embeddings into bag-level predictions.

rewrite.before_summary: Instance or patch embeddings feed a generic loss directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A MIL aggregation head converts instance embeddings into bag-level logits before loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves bag-level prediction semantics while adding explicit instance-to-bag aggregation.

operations.name: SpecAugment
operations.intent: Insert spectrogram masking augmentation before the forward pass.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Apply SpecAugment (frequency/time masking) or SpecAugment (time/frequency masking) to spectrogram-like inputs during training.

rewrite.before_summary: Training batches feed the forward pass unchanged.
rewrite.after_summary: Frequency and time masking are applied to spectrogram-like batches before the forward pass.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves input/output tensor semantics while increasing augmentation coverage.

operations.name: Non-Maximum Suppression
operations.intent: Insert post-forward suppression for overlapping detections or triplets.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use Class-aware Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) or Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) for triplets after detection predictions.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass detections feed loss computation or output directly.
rewrite.after_summary: NMS-filtered detections feed loss computation or output.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves detection semantics while removing duplicate overlapping predictions.

operations.name: Stochastic Depth
operations.intent: Insert residual-path regularization for deep residual, convolutional, or transformer layers.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Randomly drop residual paths during training with stochastic depth or DropPath-style regularization.

rewrite.before_summary: Training batches feed every residual or transformer layer deterministically.
rewrite.after_summary: Stochastic depth regularization is applied before residual or transformer forward passes.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves model outputs while regularizing residual-path training dynamics.

operations.name: Coordinate Regression Head
operations.intent: Insert a coordinate, offset, or continuous-geometry prediction head before loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a head that predicts 2D or 3D coordinates, xyz values, keypoints, offsets, or other continuous geometry targets from neural features.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed a generic loss or generic prediction head.
rewrite.after_summary: Forward-pass features feed a coordinate-regression head before geometry-aware loss computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves sample-level prediction semantics while changing the output head to continuous coordinates or offsets.

operations.name: Spatio-Temporal U-Net Attention
operations.intent: Insert a 3D U-Net-style backbone with spatio-temporal attention before task loss computation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use a 3D U-Net, volumetric U-Net, or U-Net-style frame/slice encoder with spatio-temporal attention for video-like, slice-stack, or volume inputs.

rewrite.before_summary: Forward-pass features feed a generic head or loss computation.
rewrite.after_summary: Forward-pass features pass through a 3D U-Net-style spatio-temporal attention block before the task head or loss.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves prediction targets while adding volumetric or temporal context and attention over slices, frames, or local 3D neighborhoods.

audit.rationale: Standardizes provider-owned metadata for neural-network expansion rules implemented in sciona-matcher.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These refinements add checks for exploding gradients, inactive activations, stalled loss, and imbalanced weights in deep-learning pipelines.

migration_readiness.rationale: Provider asset is aligned to current matcher rule names and grounded in DL architecture, training, and loss CDGs.

uncertainty_notes: Trigger thresholds mirror current matcher diagnostics and may be refined with provider benchmark evidence.

references.title: Matcher neural_network expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/neural_network.py.
